When connecting the wires from the blower motor, please note which wire connects to the HEAT and COOL terminals on the *G7 control board. See Table 1. NOTE: If the motor does not have an orange wire, do not place any wire on the Medium Low terminal, this should be left empty. The 6 pin (P1) and the 9 pin (P2) wire plugs will connect directly to the 624690 control board, there is no need to change any wire position. Wiring errors can cause improper and dangerous operation. Verify proper operation after servicing. These instructions describe how to properly replace a single stage *G6/L1 control board (PN 624631) with a *G7 control board (PN 624690). Installation procedure When replacing the *G6/L1 control board (PN 624631) with a *G7 control board (PN 624690), install all wires from the door switch and 24V transformer on the same pin locations they were removed from.
